text:
You need an exact ordinals.com-style site for Dogecoin, with indexing and thumbnail display only.

I’m Tobias Reyne, a full-stack developer with 7 years of experience using JavaScript, TypeScript, React, Next.js, Node.js, PostgreSQL, REST APIs, Tailwind CSS, Stripe, HTML, and CSS. I’ve built a white-label booking platform for fitness studios with Next.js, Node.js, PostgreSQL, Prisma, and Stripe, and helped onboard 64 studios in 6 months. I also built a live fleet dashboard with React, Socket.IO, Node.js, Redis, and Mapbox that tracked 1,800 trucks live with under 2 seconds from ping to screen.

For this project, I’d estimate 40–60 hours to completion, depending on how the Dogecoin indexing data is exposed and whether the ordinals.com layout needs pixel-level matching. I can likely get it live in 1–2 weeks once access and requirements are clear.

Do you already have the Dogecoin indexing source or RPC access, or should I plan to build that part as well?
